title: Open the Tier 6 hunt
description:
The Night Lich and Void Blossom offer alternative Overworld milestones. A Bastion is a Tier 5 structure; a Nether Fortress is Tier 4.

Open the Tier 6 hunt.

This entry records that you read the advice. It does not detect a fight, gear quality, a completed expedition or a claimed reward.
